summary: PR #2 adds client-side todo search (input + filter + highlight). The feature works for the happy path but has a high-severity XSS vector via unescaped highlight HTML, a performance gap (no debounce, full re-render per keystroke), and meaningful test gaps around case handling and empty states. Needs fixes before merge.

issues.message: Search highlight injects raw todo titles into innerHTML without escaping, enabling stored XSS via a malicious todo title.
issues.suggestion: Escape titles with escapeHtml() before wrapping matches in <mark>, or build nodes with textContent + ranges.

issues.message: Input handler re-filters and re-renders the full list on every keystroke with no debounce; large lists will jank.
issues.suggestion: Debounce input by ~150-250ms and memoize the normalized todo index.

issues.message: Case normalization applied to query but not to todo titles, so "MILK" misses "milk".
issues.suggestion: Normalize both sides with .toLowerCase().trim() (or locale-aware toLocaleLowerCase()).

issues.message: Magic number 10 (max results) inline with no explanation.

codeQuality.summary: One high-severity XSS issue dominates; plus a real perf gap and a correctness bug in case handling. Applied code-review-best-practices security checklist (injection/escaping) and ESLint findings.

suggestions.description: Case-insensitive matching is untested and currently broken.
suggestions.testCase: given todos ["Buy milk"], search "MILK" returns 1 result; assert titles equal ["Buy milk"].

suggestions.description: Empty-query and no-match states have no tests.
suggestions.testCase: given query "", returns all todos; given query "zzz-no-match", returns []; assert empty-state message shown.

suggestions.description: HTML-escaping of titles is untested (XSS regression risk).
suggestions.testCase: given title '', highlightMatch() output contains <img, never a live tag; assert no "

suggestions.description: Special regex characters in query (e.g. ".*+") are untested.
suggestions.testCase: given query ".*+", search treats it literally and does not throw; assert result count is 0.

testCoverage.summary: No dedicated search spec exists; happy-path manual testing only. Priority: escaping regression test, case-insensitivity, and empty/no-match states.

suggestions.description: Search handler mixes normalization, filtering, slicing, and rendering (~55 lines); extract buildTodoFilter(query) and renderSearchResults().
suggestions.example:
before: onInput(q){ ...filter...slice...innerHTML... }
// after: const f = buildTodoFilter(q); const hits = todos.filter(f).slice(0, MAX); renderSearchResults(hits);

suggestions.description: Replace string-concat HTML building with DOM APIs or a tiny escapeHtml() + template helper to close the XSS class of bugs.
Use AbortController/debounce + optional chaining for the input pipeline.

deadCode: src/search.js: unused function legacyFilter (superseded by searchTodos)
refactoring.summary: Feature code is one big handler; extracting filter/render helpers plus a safe-HTML helper fixes structure and the XSS pattern at once.

recommendations: Fix stored XSS: escape titles before highlight markup (highest priority).
Fix case-insensitive matching (normalize both sides) and add regression tests.
Debounce search input and cap renders with MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS.
Add search spec: case, empty, no-match, regex-chars, and escaping tests.
